li.p: You are a ham radio operator who wants to record distant stations. To save power, you shut down the receiver during the day, because long-distance signals travel better after dark.

text.tspan: You are a ham radio operator who wants to record distant stations. To save power, you shut down the
receiver during the day, because long-distance signals travel better after dark.
Input whether is_nighttime and the signal_strength.
If signal_strength is greater than 50, record the signal.Otherwise, do not record.Otherwise (daytime), turn
